title: Redoing Make - Haskell from Scratch #1
summary: The first episode of a screencast series building djb's redo build system from scratch in Haskell. It explains the purpose of redo, writes initial code and sets up a GitHub repository.
why: Recommended to Haskell learners as a rare example of building a real program step by step beyond toy examples.

quote.text: the Jekor Redo [1] videos are fantastic, and demonstrate the slow building up of more complicated things than "reverse this string.
